summary: Native Android release 0.5.18 (versionCode 20): ships the Android work merged since 0.5.17. Pull requests on the phone (phone-pull-requests.json): a Reviews tab, filters, the PR detail and Work on PR on the PR's own branch; one collapsible row per subagent (subagent-rows); chip open by source; the Codex permission card that lists every path. Room migration 7 to 8 adds a nullable outbox column for a queued review chip.

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; the desktop parts of each shipped feature are covered by that feature's own manifest.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own OTA and build lanes; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API change; the backend contracts these Android features use are covered by their own manifests.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump.

notExercised: Installing the update on a physical device through the in-app updater.
